description:
Stores a profile for this conversation so assessments use Dietary Reference Intakes.

Age- and sex-specific U.S. Dietary Reference Intakes replace the generic
food-label values. The result lists the resolved daily targets and limits.
The profile is held in memory for the conversation, replaces any earlier
profile, and is not written to disk.

activity.description: Activity level, used only for the calorie estimate. Defaults to moderate.

height_cm.description: Height in centimeters; with weight_kg, adds a calorie estimate and the saturated-fat and sugar limits derived from it.

life_stage.description: Pregnancy and lactation apply only with sex female. Defaults to none.

sex.description: Sex that selects the reference values.

weight_kg.description: Body weight in kilograms; adds a 0.8 g/kg protein target.

name: set_profile
